cn_steps: 启用 `Post Process Material Chain Graph`（运行时 `PPMChainGraph`，编辑器 `PPMChainGraphEditor`）。
它允许堆叠后期处理材质，并渲染到与 Scene Color 分开的 Render Target。
用它在不写回场景颜色的情况下，对其它纹理做后期处理链。
属实验性后期处理工具；Game 模块依赖运行时，编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Post Process Material Chain Graph` (runtime `PPMChainGraph`, editor `PPMChainGraphEditor`).
It lets you stack post-process materials and render them into render targets separate from Scene Color.
Use it to operate on textures other than scene color without writing them back to scene color.
It is an experimental post-process tool; game modules depend on runtime, editor modules are Editor-target only.
note_cn: 把后期处理材质链渲染到独立 RT（可不写 Scene Color）。
note_en: Stack post-process materials into separate RTs (not Scene Color).

cn_steps: 启用 `Pre-Load Screen Movie Player`（模块 `PreLoadScreenMoviePlayer`）。
它提供用预加载屏幕播放引擎加载影片的默认实现。
在启动/加载阶段配置预加载屏幕影片，而不是空白加载。
属启动体验插件；按项目需要启用。
en_steps: Enable `Pre-Load Screen Movie Player` (module `PreLoadScreenMoviePlayer`).
It is the default implementation of using a pre-load screen to display an engine loading movie.
Configure a loading movie on the pre-load screen instead of a blank load.
It is a startup-experience plugin; enable per project need.
note_cn: 预加载屏幕播放引擎加载影片的默认实现。
note_en: Default pre-load screen implementation for an engine loading movie.

cn_steps: 启用 `Pregen Content`（共享内容插件，无独立运行时模块列表）。
它提供 USD Pregen 的共享内容资产，可在多个项目中复用。
在 USD 预生成/导入流程里引用这些共享资产，而不是每个项目各拷一份。
属实验性导入管线内容；配合 USD Pregen 使用。
en_steps: Enable `Pregen Content` (shared content plugin; no separate runtime module list).
It ships shared content assets for USD Pregen, reusable across projects.
Reference these shared assets in USD pregen/import flows instead of copying them per project.
It is experimental import-pipeline content; used with USD Pregen.
note_cn: USD Pregen 的跨项目共享内容资产。
note_en: Shared USD Pregen content assets usable across projects.

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Entity Framework Interop`（运行时 `PCGEntityFrameworkInterop`，编辑器 `PCGEntityFrameworkInteropEditor`）。
它让 PCG 与 Scene Graph 实体和 Verse 标签交互。
在 PCG 图里读写实体/Verse 标签，把程序化生成接到场景图。
属实验性 PCG 互操作；需启用 PCG。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Entity Framework Interop` (runtime `PCGEntityFrameworkInterop`, editor `PCGEntityFrameworkInteropEditor`).
It lets PCG interact with Scene Graph entities and Verse tags.
Read/write entities/Verse tags from PCG graphs to hook procedural generation into the scene graph.
It is experimental PCG interop; requires PCG enabled.
note_cn: PCG 与 Scene Graph 实体 / Verse 标签的互操作。
note_en: PCG interop with Scene Graph entities and Verse tags.

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) External Data Interop`（运行时 `PCGExternalDataInterop`，编辑器 `PCGExternalDataInteropEditor`）。
它让 PCG 与外部数据格式交互。
在 PCG 图里导入/消费外部数据源，驱动点云或生成规则。
属实验性 PCG 互操作；需启用 PCG。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) External Data Interop` (runtime `PCGExternalDataInterop`, editor `PCGExternalDataInteropEditor`).
It lets PCG interact with external data formats.
Import/consume external data sources in PCG graphs to drive point clouds or spawn rules.
It is experimental PCG interop; requires PCG enabled.
note_cn: PCG 与外部数据格式的互操作。
note_en: PCG interop with external data formats.

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) FastGeo Interop`（模块 `PCGFastGeoInterop`）。
它让 PCG 与 FastGeo 几何加速/处理管线互操作。
在 PCG 图里把 FastGeo 结果接到散布、切割或采样节点。
属实验性 PCG 互操作；需启用 PCG 与 FastGeo。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) FastGeo Interop` (module `PCGFastGeoInterop`).
It lets PCG interoperate with the FastGeo geometry acceleration/processing pipeline.
Wire FastGeo results into scatter, cut, or sample nodes in PCG graphs.
It is experimental PCG interop; requires PCG and FastGeo.
note_cn: PCG 与 FastGeo 几何管线的互操作。
note_en: PCG interop with the FastGeo geometry pipeline.

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Geometry Script Interop`（模块 `PCGGeometryScriptInterop`）。
它让 PCG 与 Geometry Script 交互。
在 PCG 图里调用几何脚本节点，对生成出的网格做程序化建模。
属实验性 PCG 互操作；需启用 PCG 与 Geometry Script。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Geometry Script Interop` (module `PCGGeometryScriptInterop`).
It lets PCG interact with Geometry Script.
Call Geometry Script nodes from PCG graphs to procedurally model generated meshes.
It is experimental PCG interop; requires PCG and Geometry Script.
note_cn: PCG 与 Geometry Script 的互操作。

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Instanced Actors Interop`（模块 `PCGInstancedActorsInterop`）。
它让 PCG 与 Instanced Actors 系统互操作。
在 PCG 图里把点云输出写成实例化 Actor，而不是逐个普通 Actor。
属实验性 PCG 互操作；需启用 PCG 与 Instanced Actors。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Instanced Actors Interop` (module `PCGInstancedActorsInterop`).
It lets PCG interoperate with the Instanced Actors system.
Write PCG point-cloud output as instanced actors instead of one regular actor per point.
It is experimental PCG interop; requires PCG and Instanced Actors.
note_cn: PCG 与 Instanced Actors 的互操作。

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Mesh Partition Interop`（运行时 `PCGMeshPartitionInterop`，编辑器 `PCGMeshPartitionInteropEditor`）。
它让 PCG 与网格分区互操作。
在 PCG 图里按网格分区采样/散布，分区结果驱动生成。
属实验性 PCG 互操作；需启用 PCG。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Mesh Partition Interop` (runtime `PCGMeshPartitionInterop`, editor `PCGMeshPartitionInteropEditor`).
It lets PCG interoperate with mesh partitioning.
Sample/scatter in PCG graphs from mesh partitions so partition results drive generation.
It is experimental PCG interop; requires PCG enabled.
note_cn: PCG 与网格分区的互操作。

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Nanite Assemblies Interop`（模块 `PCGNaniteAssembliesInterop`）。
它让 PCG 与 Nanite Assemblies 互操作。
在 PCG 图里生成/放置 Nanite 装配体，而不是普通静态网格实例。
属实验性 PCG 互操作；需启用 PCG 与 Nanite Assemblies。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Nanite Assemblies Interop` (module `PCGNaniteAssembliesInterop`).
It lets PCG interoperate with Nanite Assemblies.
Generate/place Nanite assemblies from PCG graphs instead of regular static-mesh instances.
It is experimental PCG interop; requires PCG and Nanite Assemblies.
note_cn: PCG 与 Nanite Assemblies 的互操作。

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Niagara Interop`（模块 `PCGNiagaraInterop`）。
它让 PCG 与 Niagara 特效系统互操作。
在 PCG 图里把点云/变换喂给 Niagara，或用 Niagara 数据驱动生成。
属实验性 PCG 互操作；需启用 PCG 与 Niagara。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Niagara Interop` (module `PCGNiagaraInterop`).
It lets PCG interoperate with Niagara.
Feed PCG point clouds/transforms into Niagara, or drive generation from Niagara data.
It is experimental PCG interop; requires PCG and Niagara.
note_cn: PCG 与 Niagara 的互操作。

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Python Interop`（模块 `PCGPythonInteropEditor`）。
它让 PCG 与编辑器 Python 解释器交互。
用 Python 脚本创建/修改 PCG 图或在图中调用 Python。
属实验性编辑器互操作；只进 Editor Target，需 PCG 与 Python 脚本插件。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Python Interop` (module `PCGPythonInteropEditor`).
It lets PCG interact with the editor Python interpreter.
Create/modify PCG graphs from Python, or call Python from graphs.
It is experimental editor interop; Editor-target only, requires PCG and the Python script plugin.
note_cn: PCG 与编辑器 Python 解释器的互操作。
note_en: PCG interop with the editor Python interpreter.

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Water Interop`（模块 `PCGWaterInterop`）。
它让 PCG 与 Water 水体系统互操作。
在 PCG 图里沿河流/湖泊样条采样或避开水面生成内容。
属实验性 PCG 互操作；需启用 PCG 与 Water。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG) Water Interop` (module `PCGWaterInterop`).
It lets PCG interoperate with the Water system.
Sample along river/lake splines or keep generated content off the water surface in PCG graphs.
It is experimental PCG interop; requires PCG and Water.
note_cn: PCG 与 Water 水体系统的互操作。
note_en: PCG interop with the Water system.

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG)`（模块 `PCG`、`PCGEditor`、`PCGCompute`）。
它用节点图在编辑器或运行时程序化生成关卡内容：点云、变换、网格、植被与生成规则，可和景观、HLOD、Nanite 配合。
创建 PCG Graph，放到体积/关卡里执行，再按需启用各 PCG Interop 插件。
Game 模块依赖 `PCG`/`PCGCompute`；`PCGEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Content Generation Framework (PCG)` (modules `PCG`, `PCGEditor`, `PCGCompute`).
It is a node graph for procedural level content in editor or at runtime: point clouds, transforms, meshes, foliage, and spawn rules, working with Landscape, HLOD, and Nanite.
Create a PCG Graph, execute it from a volume/level, then enable PCG Interop plugins as needed.
Game modules depend on `PCG`/`PCGCompute`; `PCGEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: PCG 主插件：节点图程序化生成关卡内容。
note_en: Main PCG plugin: node-graph procedural level content.

cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Mesh Component`（运行时 `ProceduralMeshComponent`，编辑器 `ProceduralMeshComponentEditor`）。
它提供可渲染组件和工具库，用于按程序创建和修改网格几何。
在 Actor 上加 Procedural Mesh Component，运行时填顶点/三角形生成网格。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。更复杂建模可考虑 Geometry Script。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Mesh Component` (runtime `ProceduralMeshComponent`, editor `ProceduralMeshComponentEditor`).
It provides a renderable component and utility library for creating and modifying mesh geometry procedurally.
Add a Procedural Mesh Component on an actor and fill vertices/triangles at runtime.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; editor modules are Editor-target only. For heavier modeling, consider Geometry Script.
note_cn: 运行时程序化创建/修改网格的可渲染组件。
note_en: Renderable component to create/modify meshes procedurally at runtime.
